name: Manuka 系（studio jingo：Manuka / Kumaly / Rindo / Selestia）
name_en: Manuka family (studio jingo: Manuka / Kumaly / Rindo / Selestia)
description: studio jingo 的 Manuka、Kumaly、Rindo、Selestia 共用的原生形态键（eye_close_L、eye_jito_L、brow_anger_L、mouth_smile_L 等）。成员之间个别键的形变不同，已在通道说明里注明；标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Native shape keys shared by studio jingo's Manuka, Kumaly, Rindo and Selestia (eye_close_L, eye_jito_L, brow_anger_L, mouth_smile_L, ...). Where a key deforms differently between them the channel note says so; mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: brow_tail_up_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 8.4mm（kumaly）。网格里没有 brow_tail_up_L 时用 brow_up_L。Kumaly 有 brow_tail_up（只提眉尾）；其余成员用 brow_up，整条眉毛上移，会带眉头。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 8.4 mm (kumaly). Uses brow_up_L when the mesh has no brow_tail_up_L. Kumaly has brow_tail_up (outer brow only); the others use brow_up, the whole brow up, the inner brow comes along. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: brow_tail_up_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 8.4mm（kumaly）。网格里没有 brow_tail_up_R 时用 brow_up_R。Kumaly 有 brow_tail_up（只提眉尾）；其余成员用 brow_up，整条眉毛上移，会带眉头。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 8.4 mm (kumaly). Uses brow_up_R when the mesh has no brow_tail_up_R. Kumaly has brow_tail_up (outer brow only); the others use brow_up, the whole brow up, the inner brow comes along. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: brow_down_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 8.2mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 8.2 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: brow_down_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 8.2mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 8.2 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: brow_head_up_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 9.3mm（kumaly）。网格里没有 brow_head_up_L 时用 brow_tare_L。Kumaly 用 brow_head_up（眉头上提）；Manuka / Rindo 的 brow_tare 眉头上提、眉尾下垂；Selestia 的 brow_tare 只压眉尾，眉头不动
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 9.3 mm (kumaly). Uses brow_tare_L when the mesh has no brow_head_up_L. Kumaly uses brow_head_up (inner brow up); Manuka / Rindo's brow_tare raises the inner brow and lowers the outer brow; Selestia's brow_tare only lowers the outer brow, the inner brow stays

channels.name: brow_head_up_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 9.3mm（kumaly）。网格里没有 brow_head_up_R 时用 brow_tare_R。Kumaly 用 brow_head_up（眉头上提）；Manuka / Rindo 的 brow_tare 眉头上提、眉尾下垂；Selestia 的 brow_tare 只压眉尾，眉头不动
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 9.3 mm (kumaly). Uses brow_tare_R when the mesh has no brow_head_up_R. Kumaly uses brow_head_up (inner brow up); Manuka / Rindo's brow_tare raises the inner brow and lowers the outer brow; Selestia's brow_tare only lowers the outer brow, the inner brow stays

channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 8.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: brow_anger_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 8.4mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 8.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_close_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 16.4mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 16.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_close_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 16.4mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 16.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_jito_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 6.0mm（kumaly）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 6.0 mm (kumaly)

channels.name: eye_jito_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 6.0mm（kumaly）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 6.0 mm (kumaly)

channels.name: eye_open_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 3.2mm（kumaly）。Kumaly / Rindo 外侧上睑略升约 1mm；Manuka / Selestia 几乎看不出睁大。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 3.2 mm (kumaly). Kumaly / Rindo: the outer upper lid rises about 1 mm; Manuka / Selestia barely widen. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_open_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 3.2mm（kumaly）。Kumaly / Rindo 外侧上睑略升约 1mm；Manuka / Selestia 几乎看不出睁大。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 3.2 mm (kumaly). Kumaly / Rindo: the outer upper lid rises about 1 mm; Manuka / Selestia barely widen. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_under_up_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 1.6mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 1.6 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_under_up_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 1.6mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 1.6 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_a
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 10.2mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop / lowerLipDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 10.2 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop / lowerLipDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_u
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 6.2mm（kumaly）。u 口型带张嘴
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 6.2 mm (kumaly). "u" shape with the mouth open

channels.name: mouth_smile_L
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 2.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_smile_R
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 2.4 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_L
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（左侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（kumaly）。Kumaly / Selestia 嘴角下压；Manuka 是唇中上拱的 ∩ 形，嘴角本身几乎不降。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 2.2 mm (kumaly). Kumaly / Selestia: mouth corners down; Manuka: a ∩ shape with the lip centre arched up, the corners barely drop. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_R
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（kumaly）。Kumaly / Selestia 嘴角下压；Manuka 是唇中上拱的 ∩ 形，嘴角本身几乎不降。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 2.2 mm (kumaly). Kumaly / Selestia: mouth corners down; Manuka: a ∩ shape with the lip centre arched up, the corners barely drop. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_L
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（左侧）。最大位移 1.9mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (left). Max displacement 1.9 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_R
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（右侧）。最大位移 1.9mm（kumaly）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (right). Max displacement 1.9 mm (kumaly). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_narrow_L
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（左侧）。最大位移 2.1mm（kumaly）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (left). Max displacement 2.1 mm (kumaly)

channels.name: mouth_narrow_R
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（右侧）。最大位移 2.1mm（kumaly）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (right). Max displacement 2.1 mm (kumaly)

channels.name: mouth_H_L
channels.note: 抿嘴（嘴角收紧）（左侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（kumaly）。嘴角向内收紧，近似抿嘴
channels.note_en: Lips pressed (corners tightened) (left). Max displacement 2.2 mm (kumaly). Mouth corners tighten inward, close to a lip press

channels.name: mouth_H_R
channels.note: 抿嘴（嘴角收紧）（右侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（kumaly）。嘴角向内收紧，近似抿嘴
channels.note_en: Lips pressed (corners tightened) (right). Max displacement 2.2 mm (kumaly). Mouth corners tighten inward, close to a lip press

channels.name: mouth_crooked_L
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色左侧。最大位移 8.0mm（kumaly）。仅 Kumaly 有；是歪嘴口型（嘴角扭曲、收拢），不是纯平移
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's left. Max displacement 8.0 mm (kumaly). Kumaly only; a crooked mouth (corners twisted and drawn in), not a pure shift

channels.name: mouth_crooked_R
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色右侧。最大位移 8.0mm（kumaly）。仅 Kumaly 有；是歪嘴口型（嘴角扭曲、收拢），不是纯平移
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's right. Max displacement 8.0 mm (kumaly). Kumaly only; a crooked mouth (corners twisted and drawn in), not a pure shift

channels.name: eye_up
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 3.8mm（kumaly）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 3.8 mm (kumaly). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_down
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 4.3mm（kumaly）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 4.3 mm (kumaly). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_left
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 3.9mm（kumaly）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 3.9 mm (kumaly). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_right
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 3.9mm（kumaly）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 3.9 mm (kumaly). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
